description: This file declares functions and structures related to constructing and manipulating file system paths within a Git repository. It includes path creation functions, path normalization, permission adjustments, and utilities for handling subdirectories, worktrees, and submodules.

methods.name: mkpath
methods.description: Returns a statically allocated path formatted according to the printf-style format.

methods.name: mkpathdup
methods.description: Returns a newly allocated duplicated path formatted according to printf.

methods.name: repo_common_path
methods.description: Constructs a path within the repository's shared git directory.

methods.name: repo_git_path
methods.description: Constructs a path within the repository's git directory, with adjustments for special paths.

methods.name: worktree_git_path
methods.description: Constructs a git path for a specified worktree or the main worktree if none is specified.

methods.name: repo_worktree_path
methods.description: Constructs a path within a repository's worktree.

methods.name: repo_submodule_path
methods.description: Constructs a path within a submodule's git directory.

methods.name: report_linked_checkout_garbage
methods.description: Reports garbage in a linked checkout.

methods.name: git_path_squash_msg
methods.description: Returns the path for the squash message file in the git repository.

methods.name: ends_with_path_components
methods.description: Checks if a path ends with specified components.

methods.name: calc_shared_perm
methods.description: Calculates shared permissions for a repository.

methods.name: adjust_shared_perm
methods.description: Adjusts permissions on a path to match shared repository settings.

methods.name: interpolate_path
methods.description: Interpolates environment variables into a path.

methods.name: remove_leading_path
methods.description: Removes a leading prefix from a path.

methods.name: relative_path
methods.description: Calculates a relative path with respect to a prefix.

methods.name: normalize_path_copy_len
methods.description: Normalizes a path copy with length output.

methods.name: normalize_path_copy
methods.description: Normalizes a path copy.

methods.name: strbuf_normalize_path
methods.description: Normalizes the path stored in a strbuf.

methods.name: longest_ancestor_length
methods.description: Determines the length of the longest ancestor prefix.

methods.name: strip_path_suffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix from a path.

methods.name: daemon_avoid_alias
methods.description: Determines if a path should avoid aliasing in daemon mode.

methods.name: is_ntfs_dotgit
methods.description: Checks if a filename corresponds to .git on NTFS.

methods.name: is_ntfs_dotgitmodules
methods.description: Checks if a filename is .gitmodules on NTFS.

methods.name: is_ntfs_dotgitignore
methods.description: Checks if a filename is .gitignore on NTFS.

methods.name: is_ntfs_dotgitattributes
methods.description: Checks if a filename is .gitattributes on NTFS.

methods.name: is_ntfs_dotmailmap
methods.description: Checks if a filename is .mailmap on NTFS.

methods.name: looks_like_command_line_option
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles a command-line option.

methods.name: xdg_config_home_for
methods.description: Constructs the path to a config file based on XDG and environment variables.

methods.name: xdg_config_home
methods.description: Returns the path to the XDG config home for a given filename.

methods.name: xdg_cache_home
methods.description: Returns the path to the XDG cache home for a given filename.

methods.name: safe_create_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory under $GIT_DIR, adjusting permissions if needed.

methods.name: safe_create_dir_in_gitdir
methods.description: Creates a directory inside the git directory, resolving symlinks and adjusting permissions.

methods.name: safe_create_leading_directories
methods.description: Creates parent directories for a given path with race condition handling.

methods.name: safe_create_leading_directories_const
methods.description: Creates parent directories without modifying the input path.

methods.name: safe_create_leading_directories_no_share
methods.description: Creates parent directories ignoring shared repository permissions.

methods.name: safe_create_file_with_leading_directories
methods.description: Creates a file and its parent directories as needed.
